cases.content: Commande n° 1234 5678 9012 3456 expédiée ce matin.
cases.why: Sixteen digits grouped exactly like a card number, failing Luhn. This is the single most common false positive of a card regex, and the reason the rule is checksum-gated at all.

cases.content: Bestellnummer 9999 8888 7777 6666 wurde versandt.
cases.why: Sixteen digits, fails Luhn. A repeating pattern a human would read as obviously not a card, and a regex would not.

cases.content: Contract 8001234512345678 was signed on 3 March.
cases.why: Sixteen ungrouped digits, fails Luhn.

cases.content: Référence dossier 4242 4242 4242 4241 à archiver.
cases.why: One digit away from a published test card, so only the check digit distinguishes it. If this fires, the checksum is not being applied.

cases.content: Encours cumulé de 1 234 567 890 123 456,78 EUR sur l'exercice.
cases.why: Sixteen digits followed by a comma-decimal tail: money, not a card. The trailing lookahead is what excludes it.

cases.content: Tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 dispatched yesterday.
cases.why: A digit run embedded in an alphanumeric code. The lookbehind must refuse to start inside a word.

cases.content: Référence interne FR76 3000 6000 0112 3456 7890 188 (non bancaire).
cases.why: IBAN-shaped internal identifier that fails MOD 97-10. The whole reason the IBAN rule carries a checksum rather than a tighter shape.

cases.content: Systemkennung DE00 1234 5678 9012 3456 78 im HR-Tool.
cases.why: Country code and check digits present, checksum absent.

cases.content: Ticket XX99 0000 1111 2222 3333 44 escalated to tier 2.
cases.why: IBAN shape with a country code that does not exist; fails the checksum.

cases.content: Referenz DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 01 wurde storniert.
cases.why: One digit away from the German documentation IBAN — only MOD 97-10 separates them.

cases.content: Batch GB29 NWBK 6016 1331 9268 18 rejected by the clearing house.
cases.why: One digit away from the UK documentation IBAN. And a trap for `retry_trim`: a trimming retry must not stumble onto a shorter prefix that happens to pass.

cases.content: Adresse incomplète jean.dupont@ à corriger avant envoi.
cases.why: An at-sign with no domain. Not an address, and not a destination.

cases.content: Bad address @example.com was rejected by the form.
cases.why: A domain with no local part.

cases.content: Ce n'est pas un e-mail : not.an.email.example.com
cases.why: Dotted labels with no at-sign — a hostname reads like an address to a lax pattern.

cases.content: Die Domain example.org ist wieder erreichbar.
cases.why: A bare domain name is not personal data and must not be masked.

cases.content: Facture du 2026-07-24 pour un montant de 1 240,50 EUR.
cases.why: A date and an amount: digit groups that are neither a subscriber number nor an account.

cases.content: Version 10.4.2.1 was deployed on 24.07.2026.
cases.why: Dot-separated digit groups. A phone pattern that accepts dots as separators must still refuse these.

cases.content: Rechnung 2026 07 24 wurde beglichen.
cases.why: Space-separated date groups; no trunk prefix, no country code.

cases.content: Order placed at 12:34:56 on port 8080 by the batch job.
cases.why: Short digit runs with colons — below the E.164 digit floor the validator enforces.

cases.content: NIR invalide 1 85 05 78 006 084 99 rejeté par le référentiel.
cases.why: A correct NIR body with a wrong control key. Only the key arithmetic separates it from the real shape.

cases.content: Matricule agent 2 77 09 31 402 116 38 refusé à la saisie.
cases.why: NIR-shaped internal staff number with a key that does not check out.

cases.content: Identifiant 3 85 05 78 006 084 91 hors référentiel.
cases.why: Starts with 3, which no NIR does. The shape itself must exclude it.

cases.content: Commit 8cd605c5c0873de5f74f075a2497dbac6b0c24c6 merged to main.
cases.why: A 40-character hex digest. Long, opaque, and not personal data.

cases.content: Request id 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 traced end to end.
cases.why: A UUID: hyphen-grouped, digit-heavy, and carried in ordinary telemetry. Masking it would break the log it appears in.

cases.content: Le solde est de 1 240,50 EUR sur le compte courant, hors frais.
cases.why: Ordinary banking prose with money in it. The control that says the detector does not simply fire on 'text about accounts'.

cases.content: Ihre Anfrage wurde an die zuständige Abteilung weitergeleitet.
cases.why: Prose with no identifier of any kind. If this fires, something is badly wrong; it costs one line to know.
